text: Teen depression: sadness lasting more than two weeks, withdrawal, academic decline, changes in sleep/appetite. It is not just a mood—it is an illness that has treatment.

review_defects.english: It is not just a mood
review_defects.why: The Arabic states categorically 'it is not a mood', while the English adds 'just', implying it is a mood but more than that. This softens the original assertion.
